subject: English
question_text: Make six sentences using the parts of sentences from each column of the table below:
stimulus: Trees give very useful to us. should not destroy oxygen to breathe to live. They are trees. need oxygen to breathe to live. We Save shelters to birds and animals. provide us from flood and natural calamities.
guide_solution: (a) Trees are very useful to us. (b) They give oxygen to breathe to live. (c) We need oxygen to breathe to live. (d) They provide shelters to birds and animals. (e) We should not destroy trees. (f) They save us from flood and natural calamities.
